lines.en: label secondbeach11floor1 （一楼获胜）
label secondbeach11floor1:
I stop by my room before heading over to the one the first floor girls are staying in to get changed into something more comfortable.
lines.zh: 在去一楼女生们住的房间之前，我先回自己房间换了身更舒服的衣服。

lines.en: The good thing about this is that it means I won’t be going to sleep in jeans tonight.
lines.zh: 好处是，这意味着我今晚不用穿着牛仔裤睡觉了。

lines.en: The bad thing, however, is that it is much harder to conceal an erection in sweatpants.
lines.zh: 坏处是，穿着运动裤要藏住勃起可难多了。

lines.en: And given the fact that there are soon to be ten cute girls (Or less, if any of them were either kidnapped or killed tonight) paying attention to me, an erection seems very likely in the future.
lines.zh: 而且考虑到接下来会有十个可爱的女生（也可能更少，如果今晚她们中有谁被绑架或弄死的话）把注意力放在我身上，勃起这种事在不久的将来似乎非常可能发生。

lines.en: But hey, I’m sure that sort of thing would go over a lot better in the first floor room than it would in the second, give or take several notable exceptions.
lines.zh: 不过话说回来，这种事发生在一楼房间总比发生在二楼要好对付得多——当然，几个值得一提的例外除外。

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover1
I make my way into the room with a pep in my step and a dream in my heart.
lines.zh: 我脚步轻快、心怀梦想地走进了房间。

lines.en: Tonight is the night I have sex with ten girls at once.
lines.zh: 今晚就是我一次性跟十个女生上床的夜晚。

lines.en: I take a look around the room to find everyone essentially doing their own thing and am quickly hit with my first dilemma out of what I imagine will be many.
lines.zh: 我环顾房间，发现大家基本上都在各忙各的，很快就迎来了我想象中诸多难题里的第一个。

lines.en: Who am I going to talk to first?
lines.zh: 我要先跟谁说话？

lines.en: We have all night, so I’m sure I’ll be able to spend at least a {i}little{/i} time with everyone, but...
lines.zh: 我们有一整晚的时间，所以我相信至少能跟每个人待上{i}一小会儿{/i}，不过……

lines.en: Well...I guess there’d be even less use in standing around. So I should probably just make a decision now.
lines.zh: 嗯……我想干站着就更没意义了。所以我大概该现在就做个决定。

lines.en: Who do I want to talk to?
lines.zh: 我想跟谁说话？

lines.en: menu floor1sleepovermenu:
Futaba & Makoto
lines.zh: Futaba 和 Makoto

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover2
: Oh, excellent timing.
lines.zh: ：哦，来得正好。

lines.en: : Futaba and I were actually just talking about you.
lines.zh: ：我和 Futaba 刚才正好在聊你。

lines.en: : We were wondering if you were...actually going to show up or not.
lines.zh: ：我们在想你……到底会不会来。

lines.en: : Was that actually a real concern of yours? Because I thought it would be pretty obvious that I wouldn’t miss something like this for the world.
lines.zh: ：这真的是你们担心的事吗？我还以为我很明显绝对不会错过这种场合呢。

lines.en: : That’s what I said. Makoto is the one who disagreed.
lines.zh: ：我就是这么说的。不同意的是 Makoto。

lines.en: : What? Why?
lines.zh: ：什么？为什么？

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover3
: Well...there was the whole thing with the rules earlier.
lines.zh: ：嗯……之前不是有那套规矩的事吗。

lines.en: : So I thought that maybe you’d think things would be too boring with me here and run off to sleep with the other floor instead.
lines.zh: ：所以我想，你可能会觉得有我在这里太无聊，就跑去跟另一层的人睡了。

lines.en: : I wouldn’t have done that even if you made me stay ten feet away from everyone here at all times.
lines.zh: ：就算你让我时时刻刻都得离这里的每个人十英尺远，我也不会那么做的。

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover4
: Don’t be ridiculous. There’s not nearly enough space in this room for something like that.
lines.zh: ：别犯傻了。这房间里可没有那么大的地方让你这么干。

lines.en: : I was only going to impose a five foot rule. At least that would be manageable.
lines.zh: ：我本来只打算规定五英尺。那样至少还行得通。

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover5
: I’m kidding...
lines.zh: ：我开玩笑的……

lines.en: : I {i}am{/i} glad you showed up, though. Because this means you can join in on our discussion about literature.
lines.zh: ：不过我还是很高兴你来了。因为这意味着你可以加入我们关于文学的讨论。

lines.en: : Oh boy. How exciting.
lines.zh: ：哦天哪。真让人兴奋。

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover6
: Oh, stop...
lines.zh: ：哦，别这样……

lines.en: : You can pretend it’s boring, but Makoto and I both know you actually love reading.
lines.zh: ：你可以装作很无聊，但我和 Makoto 都知道你其实很喜欢读书。

lines.en: : And...back before you started treating all of us more like {i}friends{/i} than students, you always had so much to say about it.
lines.zh: ：而且……在你开始把我们当{i}朋友{/i}而不是学生之前，你关于这个总是有说不完的话。

lines.en: How in the world was past-me such a buzzkill when there were this many attractive girls around?
lines.zh: 身边围着这么多有魅力的女生，过去的我到底是怎么做到那么扫兴的？

lines.en: : Is that all you two planned on doing tonight? Just...talking about books?
lines.zh: ：你们今晚就打算干这个？只是……聊书？

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover7
: I’m sure the conversation would move onto other topics eventually...but both of our roommates went off and started doing their own things, so...
lines.zh: ：我相信话题迟早会转到别的东西上……不过我们俩的室友都跑去各忙各的了，所以……

lines.en: : This gave us a great opportunity to talk about what we have in common.
lines.zh: ：这给了我们一个很好的机会，聊聊我们的共同点。

lines.en: : I’ve been meaning to lend this to Futaba anyway, as I’m sure if there is anyone who would appreciate it, it’s her.
lines.zh: ：我本来就打算把这本借给 Futaba，因为我相信如果有人会欣赏它，那一定是她。

lines.en: : And what are you lending her exactly?
lines.zh: ：你到底要借给她什么？

lines.en: : A deconstruction of important events that may have led to the space war we’re currently-
lines.zh: ：一本解构那些可能导致我们目前所处的太空战争的重要事件的书——

lines.en: : I don’t think Sensei...really cares about the space war...
lines.zh: ：我觉得 Sensei……并不真的关心太空战争……

lines.en: : What space war?
lines.zh: ：什么太空战争？

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover8
: The...
lines.zh: ：就是……

lines.en: : The one that’s happening above us...
lines.zh: ：正在我们头顶上发生的那场……

lines.en: : In space...
lines.zh: ：在太空里……

lines.en: : Was there something like that going on?
lines.zh: ：有这种事在发生吗？

lines.en: : You know...sometimes I wish teachers weren’t exempt from the draft.
lines.zh: ：你知道吗……有时候我真希望老师不用免除兵役。

lines.en: : There is a lot of important information in this book that I’m sure even someone like you could-
lines.zh: ：这本书里有很多重要的信息，我相信就算是像你这样的人也能——

lines.en: : Anyway, how was {i}your{/i} day, Futaba?
lines.zh: ：总之，{i}你{/i}今天过得怎么样，Futaba？

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover9
: It was...really fun, actually.
lines.zh: ：其实……真的挺开心的。

lines.en: : Well...until a thing happened during D&D...but I’m kind of sure you don’t really want to hear about that.
lines.zh: ：嗯……直到跑团的时候出了点事……不过我大概确定你不会想听的。

lines.en: : I’m sure I wouldn’t understand either way.
lines.zh: ：不管怎样我肯定都听不懂。

lines.en: : But, on that note, I’m probably going to go say hi to a few of the other girls before the night gets a little too late.
lines.zh: ：不过，说到这个，趁天还不太晚，我大概要去找其他几个女生打个招呼了。

lines.en: : Here’s hoping they’re able to interest you a little more than {i}we{/i} did.
lines.zh: ：希望她们能比{i}我们{/i}更让你感兴趣一点。

lines.en: : Not both of you, Makoto. Just you.
lines.zh: ：不是你们两个，Makoto。只是你。

lines.en: : Bite me.
lines.zh: ：来咬我啊。

lines.en: : Sorry. Five foot rule. Your fault.
lines.zh: ：抱歉。五英尺规矩。怪你自己。

lines.zh: 那么，我想跟谁说话？

lines.en: jump floor1sleepovermenu
Rin & Maya
lines.zh: Rin 和 Maya

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover10
: Yo! What’s crackalackin’ homie? Come to chill with the t-shirt gang?
lines.zh: ：哟！怎么样啊老铁？来跟 T 恤帮一起混的？

lines.en: : The what?
lines.zh: ：什么帮？

lines.en: : You know. Cause we’re both wearing t-shirts to sleep.
lines.zh: ：你知道的。因为我们俩都穿 T 恤睡觉。

lines.en: : Okay. So are Makoto and Sana.
lines.zh: ：好吧。Makoto 和 Sana 也是啊。

lines.en: : Those don’t count. They’ve got extended neck hole thingies that reveal more skin.
lines.zh: ：那两个不算。她们领口开得老大，露的皮肤更多。

lines.en: : Maya and I are much more modest, which means that we’re more sought after than those other losers.
lines.zh: ：我和 Maya 要端庄得多，也就是说我们比那群输家更抢手。

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover11
: I don’t really see much purpose in insulting them over their wardrobe choices.
lines.zh: ：我不太明白为了人家的穿着打扮去贬低她们有什么意义。

lines.en: : I didn’t mean to. I meant “losers” in the broad sense because they’re not here right now and...we are and...I kinda want you to like me more.
lines.zh: ：我不是故意的。我说「输家」是广义上的，因为她们现在不在这儿，而……我们在，而且……我有点想让你更喜欢我一点。

lines.en: : You don’t think I dislike you, do you?
lines.zh: ：你该不会觉得我讨厌你吧？

lines.en: : No...But like, you’re always so cool and mysterious and I think it would be rad if I could...be a little more like you.
lines.zh: ：不是……不过，你总是那么酷、那么神秘，我觉得如果我能……更像你一点，那就太棒了。

lines.en: : I can promise you that you don’t want to be anything like me. I’m nothing special.
lines.zh: ：我可以向你保证，你不会想变成我这样的。我没什么特别的。

lines.en: : {i}Ahem...{/i}
scene floor1sleepover12
: What?
lines.zh: ：干嘛？

lines.en: : You are aware that you don’t have to stand there and talk to us, correct? You can leave whenever you want to.
lines.zh: ：你知道你不必站在这儿跟我们说话，对吧？你想走随时都能走。

lines.en: : Sorry for ignoring you, Sensei. It’s just been...kind of a weird night.
lines.zh: ：抱歉冷落你了，Sensei。今晚……挺奇怪的。

lines.en: : Weird in what way?
lines.zh: ：怎么个奇怪法？

lines.en: : Well...
scene floor1sleepover13
: Otoha wanted to play a game but Molly said no. But then Rin said yes. And then Otoha agreed to it being a no. But Rin kept saying yes.
lines.zh: ：Otoha 想玩游戏，Molly 说不行。然后 Rin 说可以。接着 Otoha 同意了「不行」这个结果。但 Rin 一直说可以。

lines.en: : Then there was a lot of crying. The end.
lines.zh: ：然后就哭了很久。完了。

lines.en: : Yup. That definitely sounds kind of weird to me.
lines.zh: ：是啊。听起来确实挺奇怪的。

lines.en: : Hahah...hah...
lines.zh: ：哈哈哈……哈……

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover14
: But that’s okay! Because tomorrow is gonna be the day that the thing happens and I’m trying to stay positive!
lines.zh: ：不过没关系！因为明天就是那件事发生的日子，我正努力保持积极呢！

lines.en: : Also, have you found any sheds yet?!
lines.zh: ：还有，你找到什么小屋了吗？！

lines.en: : Sheds?
lines.zh: ：小屋？

lines.en: : You know...a place for me to cry and use your shoulder as a handkerchief when I am inevitably crushed tomorrow night?
lines.zh: ：你知道的……一个能让我哭的地方，好让我明天晚上被彻底击垮的时候，把你的肩膀当手帕用？

lines.en: : Is it really okay to be talking about those plans in front of Maya?
lines.zh: ：当着 Maya 的面说这些计划，真的没问题吗？

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover15
: Why wouldn’t it be?
lines.zh: ：为什么不行？

lines.en: : Just because I’m good at remaining emotionally distant doesn’t mean I lack empathy.
lines.zh: ：我擅长保持情感上的距离，不代表我没有同理心。

lines.en: : Do I think Rin’s time would be better served on crying into the shoulder of anyone else? Of course.
lines.zh: ：我是不是觉得 Rin 把时间花在哭在别人的肩膀上会更好？当然。

lines.en: : And do I think it’s a bad idea to use you as a means of coping when you only exacerbate existing conditions to the point where they are no longer even able to be coped with? Definitely.
lines.zh: ：我是不是觉得，把你当成排解的手段是个坏主意，因为你只会让既有的状况恶化到根本无法排解的地步？绝对是。

lines.en: : Do I also believe that you’ll only pretend to care about her feelings because it will bring you one step closer to adding her to your harem? Absolutely.
lines.zh: ：我是不是也相信，你只会假装在乎她的感受，因为那能让你离把她收进后宫更近一步？毫无疑问。

lines.en: : Am I fine with the fact that-
lines.zh: ：我对此是不是也无所谓——

lines.en: : Okay, Maya. I think I get it.
lines.zh: ：好了，Maya。我想我懂了。

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover16
: I’m tired. Can you leave now, please?
lines.zh: ：我累了。你现在能走了吗？

lines.en: : ...Me? Or Sensei?
lines.zh: ：……我？还是 Sensei？

lines.en: : You can stay. He’s the exhausting one.
lines.zh: ：你可以留下。累人的是他。

lines.en: : You think {i}Rin{/i} is less exhausting than {i}me?{/i}
lines.zh: ：你觉得 {i}Rin{/i} 没{i}我{/i}那么累人？

lines.en: : That is what I said, yes.
lines.zh: ：我就是这么说的，没错。

lines.en: : Even I’m gonna go ahead and disagree with that one, Maya. I’m kind of a lot.
lines.zh: ：这个连我都要反对你了，Maya。我这人挺难搞的。

lines.en: : Luckily for you, Maya, I was just about to go talk to some of the others anyway.
lines.zh: ：算你走运，Maya，我正好也准备去找其他人聊聊了。

lines.en: : Hooray.
lines.zh: ：万岁。

lines.en: : Just try to keep the volume to a minimum.
lines.zh: ：尽量把音量压到最低。

lines.en: jump floor1sleepovermenu
Chika
lines.zh: Chika

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover17
: Oh, hey!
lines.zh: ：哦，嘿！

lines.en: if chikalust20 == True:
: Crazy seeing you here after definitely not seeing you at any other point tonight!
lines.zh: ：今晚绝对没在任何别的时间点见过你，却在这儿见到了，真巧啊！

lines.en: : Yes. This is the first time we are seeing each other in several hours.
lines.zh: ：是啊。这是我们好几个小时以来第一次见面。

lines.en: : Where have you been all day, Chika? Because it’s definitely not somewhere I have any idea of.
lines.zh: ：你一整天都去哪儿了，Chika？肯定不是我知道的地方。

lines.en: : Just...around! Definitely not walking around the woods or anything! Way too many bugs over there.
lines.zh: ：就……到处转转！绝对没有在树林里乱逛什么的！那边虫子太多了。

lines.en: else:
: I didn’t even hear you come in! I’ve been a little distracted by-
lines.zh: ：我都没听见你进来！我有点分心，因为——

lines.en: : Is that Papa?! Is Papa there?!
lines.zh: ：是 Papa 吗？！Papa 在那里吗？！

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover18
: Yes, Chinami. But please don’t call him that while you’re on speaker phone.
lines.zh: ：是的，Chinami。但你开着免提的时候别这么叫他。

lines.en: : What did I tell you about having boys over this late at night, big sister?
lines.zh: ：姐姐，我怎么跟你说的，这么晚了不许带男生回家？

lines.en: : Chinami doesn’t have the time to take care of a baby! She has important business transactions to make!
lines.zh: ：Chinami 可没时间照顾小宝宝！她还有重要的生意要谈！

lines.en: : Just kidding. Please give Chinami a little sister.
lines.zh: ：开玩笑的。请给 Chinami 生个小妹妹吧。

lines.en: : That goes for you too, Papa!
lines.zh: ：你也一样哦，Papa！

lines.en: : Chinami’s smartphone has unlocked all sorts of new information for her to learn!
lines.zh: ：Chinami 的智能手机为她解锁了各种各样的新知识！

lines.en: : She understands eeeeeeeverything now!
lines.zh: ：她现在什——么都懂了！

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover19
: Hahah...hah...heh...
lines.zh: ：哈哈哈……哈……呵……

lines.en: : Why did you think it was a good idea to let her have a phone again?
lines.zh: ：你怎么会觉得再给她一部手机是个好主意？

lines.en: : Can you blame me for not thinking she would just use it to play games all day?
lines.zh: ：我哪能想到她会整天拿它来打游戏，这能怪我吗？

lines.en: : Even parental locks were no match for her. She’s too smart.
lines.zh: ：连家长锁都拦不住她。她太聪明了。

lines.en: : Chinami isn’t just smart! She is...very smart!
lines.zh: ：Chinami 不只是聪明！她……非常聪明！

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover20
: Chinami is {i}also{/i} still awake after her bedtime.
lines.zh: ：Chinami 现在{i}也{/i}过了睡觉时间还没睡呢。

lines.en: : Do I need to come home and force you to go to sleep?
lines.zh: ：要不要我回家逼你去睡觉？

lines.en: : Chinami is a loose cannon cop on the edge with nothing to lose! She drank coffee tonight!
lines.zh: ：Chinami 是个一无所失、走钢丝的疯狂警察！她今晚喝了咖啡！

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover21
: Chinami! I told you that you can’t have coffee! You’ll get a tummy ache!
lines.zh: ：Chinami！我跟你说了不能喝咖啡！你会肚子疼的！

lines.en: : Chinami thinks it will be worth it! Her heart is going crazy! This must be what love feels like!
lines.zh: ：Chinami 觉得值了！她的心跳得好快！这一定就是恋爱的感觉！

lines.en: : Is that right, big sister?! Is Chinami feeling love?!
lines.zh: ：对吧，姐姐？！Chinami 是在恋爱了吗？！

lines.en: : I bet you’re starting to second guess leaving her alone now, huh?
lines.zh: ：我敢说你现在开始怀疑把她一个人留在家里是不是个好主意了，嗯？

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover22
: The results of that remain to be seen...
lines.zh: ：结果还有待观察……

lines.en: : Sorry, but would you let me finish up with her really quick? I just need to make sure she’s taken all of her vitamins and stuff.
lines.zh: ：抱歉，你能让我赶紧把她搞定吗？我得确认她把维生素什么的都吃了。

lines.en: : I’ll catch up with you again in a few minutes.
lines.zh: ：我几分钟后再来找你。

lines.en: : Yeah, no worries. I’ll be here all night.
lines.zh: ：行，没事。我整晚都在这儿。

lines.en: : Thanks...
lines.zh: ：谢啦……

lines.en: : Bye bye, Papa! Good luck making babies with my sister!
lines.zh: ：拜拜，Papa！祝你们造宝宝顺利！

lines.en: : Make sure you give one to big sis Yumi too! Chinami wants {i}two{/i} little sisters!
lines.zh: ：也记得给 Yumi 姐姐一个！Chinami 想要{i}两个{/i}小妹妹！

lines.en: : I’ll do my best, Chinami.
lines.zh: ：我尽力，Chinami。

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover23
: No. You most certainly will not.
lines.zh: ：不。你绝对不会。

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover24
I make my way over to Yumi to find her eyes already closed for the night.
lines.zh: 我走向 Yumi，发现她已经闭上了眼睛，准备过夜了。

lines.en: I also recognize the pillow with her as one she must have brought from her room, and the idea of her doing that is extremely cute to me.
lines.zh: 我还认出她抱着的那个枕头，一定是她从自己房间带来的，而她会这么做这件事，在我看来可爱极了。

lines.en: It’s a shame she already appears to be asleep, though...
lines.zh: 不过可惜她看起来已经睡着了……

lines.en: Not.
lines.zh: 才怪。

lines.en: : Yumi. I know you’re just faking being asleep to avoid talking to me.
lines.zh: ：Yumi。我知道你只是装睡，好躲开不跟我说话。

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover25
: Well then why the fuck would you talk to me in the first place?!
lines.zh: ：那你他妈一开始为什么非要跟我说话？！

lines.en: : If it’s obvious I don’t want to be near you, wouldn’t the rational choice be to just leave me alone?!
lines.zh: ：既然明摆着我不想靠近你，那你理性一点的选择不就是别来烦我吗？！

lines.en: : Yes. But I am a very irrational man.
lines.zh: ：是。可我是个非常不理性的男人。

lines.en: : Also, it’s way too early in this event for you to actually be sleeping. You don't want to disappoint all of your adoring fans, do you?
lines.zh: ：而且，这场活动才刚开始，你现在就睡也太早了。你总不想让所有崇拜你的粉丝失望吧？

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover26
: Event? Fans?
lines.zh: ：活动？粉丝？

lines.en: : The fuck are you talking about?
lines.zh: ：你他妈在说什么？

lines.en: : Don’t worry about it. But hey, now that you’re awake, do you want to tell me about that thing you said you...wanted to tell me about or whatever?
lines.zh: ：别在意。不过嘿，既然你醒了，要不要跟我说说你之前说……想告诉我的那件事什么的？

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover27
: I already fucking told you I would do that tomorrow, didn’t I?
lines.zh: ：我他妈不是已经跟你说了明天再说吗？

lines.en: : I still don’t really know what to say without sounding like a fuckin’ creep about it.
lines.zh: ：我还不知道该怎么说才不会听起来像个该死的变态。

lines.en: : Was probably just seein’ shit anyway, so...
lines.zh: ：而且大概只是我看花眼了，所以……

lines.en: : I wouldn’t even worry about it if I was you.
lines.zh: ：我要是你，根本就不会操心这个。

lines.en: : So it’s actually kind of serious, then?
lines.zh: ：所以其实还挺严重的？

lines.en: : Not really. More...fuckin’ weird than anything else.
lines.zh: ：也不算。与其说严重，不如说……他妈的挺诡异的。

lines.en: : But...like I said...tomorrow’s better.
lines.zh: ：不过……就像我说的……明天更好。

lines.en: : I see.
lines.zh: ：我明白了。

lines.en: : Do you have any plans during the day? Maybe we could hang out for a little while beforehand?
lines.zh: ：白天你有什么安排吗？也许我们可以在那之前先一起待一会儿？

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover28
: Why the fuck would you wanna hang out with me? You’ve got nineteen other choices who wouldn’t actually rip your dick off if given the opportunity.
lines.zh: ：你他妈为什么要跟我混在一起？你有另外十九个选择，她们逮着机会也不会真的把你鸡巴扯下来。

lines.en: : I have a hard time believing you would actually do something like that to me.
lines.zh: ：我很难相信你真会对我做那种事。

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover29
: Why? You think I’m all talk or some shit?
lines.zh: ：为什么？你觉得我只是嘴上说说什么的？

lines.en: : Of course not.
lines.zh: ：当然不是。

lines.en: : It’s just that doing that would require you willingly touching my penis- and I can’t see that happening for at least a few more beach updates.
lines.zh: ：只是那么做需要你主动碰我的鸡巴——而我看这至少还得再过几个海滩篇的更新才会发生。

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover30
: Aaaaaahhh! Ew ew ew ew ew! I don’t even want to think about that!
lines.zh: ：啊啊啊啊啊！呕呕呕呕呕！我连想都不想想这个！

lines.en: : {i}Then stop threatening me...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}：那就别再威胁我了……{/i}

lines.en: : Fine! Whatever! Just...leave me the fuck alone!
lines.zh: ：行！随便！就是……别他妈来烦我！

lines.en: : Fine, fine. I was just leaving anyway.
lines.zh: ：行行行。我本来也正要走。

lines.en: : See you tomorrow, Yumi.
lines.zh: ：明天见，Yumi。

lines.en: : Die, pig!
lines.zh: ：去死吧，猪！

Miku & Sana

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover31
: Hey, you two. What are you-
lines.zh: ：嘿，你们两个。你们在——

lines.en: : DIE! DIE! DIE!
lines.zh: ：死吧！死吧！死吧！

lines.en: : Just...playing games.
lines.zh: ：只是……在打游戏。

lines.en: : It doesn’t look like {i}you’re{/i} playing anything at all, though.
lines.zh: ：可看起来{i}你{/i}们根本没在玩什么啊。

lines.en: : Well...not right now, I’m not.
lines.zh: ：嗯……我现在确实没在玩。

lines.en: : I brought my Switch since I thought...I wouldn’t have anything else to do tonight...
lines.zh: ：我把 Switch 带来了，因为我以为……今晚我会没事可做……

lines.en: : But Miku and I were talking earlier and...she said she was interested in playing something, so...
lines.zh: ：但 Miku 和我之前聊了聊……她说她想玩点什么，所以……

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover32
: That’s right, Sensei.
lines.zh: ：没错，Sensei。

lines.en: : And with my roommate payin’ attention to books and stuff, I’m finally free to be a normal girl again!
lines.zh: ：还有，我室友正忙着看书什么的，我终于可以自由地做个正常女生了！

lines.en: : All of those days of hidin’ my love for Tetris are gone! I’m free to kill all of those stupid blocks to my heart’s content!
lines.zh: ：那些藏起我对俄罗斯方块的热爱的日子一去不复返了！我可以随心所欲地把那些破方块杀个精光！

lines.en: : Ooh. There’s a long one coming up.
lines.zh: ：哦。要来一个长条了。

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover33
: Looks like it’s gonna be a tight fit, but I can make it work!
lines.zh: ：看起来位置有点紧，不过我能搞定！

lines.en: : So uhh, ignoring that last part, you seem...really into Tetris, Miku.
lines.zh: ：那个，呃，先忽略刚才那句，你看起来……真的很喜欢俄罗斯方块啊，Miku。

lines.en: : We were gonna play somethin’ else, but the wifi is actin’ up and we’ve gotta wait for it to download.
lines.zh: ：我们本来要玩点别的，但 wifi 不太对劲，得等它下载完。

lines.en: : So, ‘til then, I’m just brushin’ up on my skills.
lines.zh: ：所以在这之前，我就先练练手。

lines.en: : Used to be crazy good with my fingers back in the day, but then I started workin’ on my legs and it aaaaall went to shit.
lines.zh: ：我以前手指头可厉害了，后来我开始练腿，就全——都完蛋了。

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover34
: EAT BLOCK YOU STUPID...BLOCK!
lines.zh: ：吃方块吧你这个蠢……方块！

lines.en: : Do you...
lines.zh: ：你要不要……

lines.en: : Do you want to try playing as well, Sensei?...
lines.zh: ：你也想试着玩玩吗，Sensei？……

lines.en: : When Miku is done, I mean...
lines.zh: ：我是说，等 Miku 玩完之后……

lines.en: : I’m okay, Sana. But thanks.
lines.zh: ：我就不了，Sana。不过谢谢。

lines.en: : Really?
lines.zh: ：真的吗？

lines.en: : I thought that...since it’s Tetris and...you’re old...you might’ve-
lines.zh: ：我以为……因为是俄罗斯方块，而且……你年纪大了……你可能会——

lines.en: : Please don’t finish that train of thought.
lines.zh: ：请别把那句话说完。

lines.en: : Besides, not all old people like Tetris...and I’m not even that old.
lines.zh: ：再说，也不是所有上年纪的人都喜欢俄罗斯方块……而且我也没那么老。

lines.en: : You’re a lot older than me.
lines.zh: ：你比我大很多。

lines.en: : Right. But please don’t compare me to some sort of father figure again because there is a time and a place for everything and neither of those are right now or right here.
lines.zh: ：是。但请别再把我比作什么父亲形象了，因为什么事都有合适的时间和地点，而现在和这里都不合适。

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover35
: That...yeah...
: That was...definitely a mistake in hindsight...
lines.zh: ：现在回想起来……那绝对是个错误……

lines.en: : Hm.
: Ya know, I can see it.
lines.zh: ：你知道吗，我挺能想象的。

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover36
: Hm? See what?
lines.zh: ：嗯？想象什么？

lines.en: : You bein’ Sensei’s daughter.
lines.zh: ：你当 Sensei 的女儿。

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover37
: Uhh...what?
lines.zh: ：呃……什么？

lines.en: : Yeah, I totally see it.
lines.zh: ：对，我真的能想象。

lines.en: : Sure, Sana’s a little on the tiny side, but if I saw you two walkin’ down the sidewalk holdin’ hands, I’d be closer to thinkin’ “Oh! Cute family!” than “Somebody call the cops!”
lines.zh: ：当然，Sana 是有点娇小，但如果我看见你们两个手牵手走在人行道上，我第一反应更可能是「哦！好可爱的一家人！」而不是「快报警！」

lines.en: : Thanks.
lines.zh: ：谢了。

lines.en: : I think.
lines.zh: ：大概吧。

lines.en: : Hey, don’t thank me. Thank your daughter for helpin’ me rediscover a brand new side of myself.
lines.zh: ：嘿，别谢我。谢你女儿吧，是她帮我重新发现了一个全新的自己。

lines.en: : I’m...not his...
lines.zh: ：我……不是他……

lines.en: : Sana, be a good girl and thank Miku for pointing out how nice of a family we are.
lines.zh: ：Sana，当个好孩子，谢谢 Miku 指出我们是多好的一家人。

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover38
: I...actually think I’m...just gonna go take a shower or something...
lines.zh: ：我……我想我还是……去洗个澡什么的……

Ami & Ayane
lines.zh: Ami 和 Ayane

lines.en: After talking to everyone else, I realize I haven’t touched base with Ami & Ayane yet.
lines.zh: 跟其他人都聊完以后，我意识到我还没跟 Ami 和 Ayane 打过照面。

lines.en: And while it would be fun to make their presence into some sort of mystery that would devolve into a search of the entire inn, I can already hear their giggling coming from the bedroom.
lines.zh: 虽然把她们的存在弄成某种谜团、最后演变成搜遍整间旅馆会挺有意思，但我已经能听见卧室里传来她们的笑声了。

lines.en: scene black
As such, I take one last glimpse at the rest of the girls in the main part of the room and slide the door open to greet my two surrogate daughters.
lines.zh: 于是，我最后看了一眼房间外头的其他女生，拉开门去问候我的两个代理女儿。

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover39
: At last! The final wing of the slumber party has begun!
lines.zh: ：终于！睡衣派对的最后一部分开始了！

lines.en: : I hope you didn’t have any other plans for the rest of the night, Sensei! Because you’re never leaving this room again.
lines.zh: ：希望你今晚剩下的时间没有别的安排，Sensei！因为你再也别想离开这个房间了。

lines.en: : Never?
lines.zh: ：永远？

lines.en: : Well, not until tomorrow.
lines.zh: ：嗯，直到明天为止。

lines.en: : That’s not even close to never.
lines.zh: ：那离永远还差得远呢。

lines.en: : I’ve gotta say, when I first came up with the idea for the dorm war, I didn’t think anybody would agree to you actually being the prize.
lines.zh: ：我得说，我刚想出宿舍大战这个点子的时候，没想到大家会同意把你真的当成奖品。

lines.en: : But, now that it’s all said and done, I couldn’t be happier.
lines.zh: ：不过，现在一切都尘埃落定了，我开心得不能再开心了。

lines.en: : I don’t see how this is much different from a normal sleepover at my house apart from the fact that there are just...more girls than normal.
lines.zh: ：我看不出这和我家普通的过夜聚会有什么大区别，除了女生……比平时多一点。

lines.en: : That’s exactly why it’s great! Because now all of them will know for sure that you love me the most.
lines.zh: ：这正是它棒的地方！因为现在她们所有人都会确定，你最爱的是我。

lines.en: : And Ayane can be second place, I guess. But it’s a really distant second place. Like I’ve already lapped her and stuff.
lines.zh: ：Ayane 大概能排第二吧。不过是差得特别远的第二。就像我已经套了她一圈什么的。

lines.en: : As you can see, I’ve just decided to let Ami believe whatever she wants as long as it helps her sleep at night.
lines.zh: ：如你所见，我已经决定让 Ami 爱信什么信什么，只要她晚上睡得着就行。

lines.en: : I can’t imagine I’ll have any trouble falling asleep tonight with Sensei right beside me.
lines.zh: ：有 Sensei 就睡在我旁边，我想我今晚肯定睡得着。

lines.en: : I’m sleeping in here?
lines.zh: ：我要睡在这儿？

lines.en: : The answer to that question is written on Ami’s pillow.
lines.zh: ：这个问题的答案写在 Ami 的枕头上。

lines.en: : The pillow says yes.
lines.zh: ：枕头说是。

lines.en: : I see that.
lines.zh: ：我看到了。

lines.en: : But...you {i}do{/i} know what that pillow actually-
lines.zh: ：不过……你知道那个枕头其实——

lines.en: : Oh, I know what the pillow means.
lines.zh: ：哦，我知道那个枕头是什么意思。

lines.en: : What happens at the beach stays at the beach.
lines.zh: ：在海滩发生的事，就留在海滩。

lines.en: : Thankfully, nothing bad has ever happened at the beach and it is nothing but good memories for all of us. Yay.
lines.zh: ：谢天谢地，海滩上从来没发生过什么坏事，对我们所有人来说全是美好的回忆。耶。

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover40
: Anyway, we’re still in agreement that Sensei will be sleeping between the two of us, correct?
lines.zh: ：总之，我们还是说好了 Sensei 睡在我们两个中间，对吧？

lines.en: : And that you won’t touch him at all?
lines.zh: ：还有你完全不能碰他？

lines.en: : Was that part of the deal? Because I can’t imagine I would have agreed to it if it was.
lines.zh: ：这算是约定里的一部分吗？因为如果是的话，我简直不敢想象我会同意。

lines.en: : It was part of the deal.
lines.zh: ：那就是约定里的一部分。

lines.en: : Hoooooow aboooout...I only touch him as much as you touch him? But also, my clothes are off.
lines.zh: ：那——不——如……你碰他多少，我就碰他多少？不过还有，我的衣服是脱掉的。

lines.en: : How about I cut you into little pieces and cook you into macaroni?
lines.zh: ：不如我把你切成小块，煮成通心粉？

lines.en: : Oooh, I love macaroni.
lines.zh: ：哦哦，我爱通心粉。

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover41
: Or, how about you two let Sensei choose where he wants to sleep instead of keeping him locked in here?
lines.zh: ：或者，你们两个让 Sensei 自己选他想睡哪儿，而不是把他锁在这里？

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover42
: I’m off the phone now.
lines.zh: ：我挂电话了。

lines.en: : I...can see that.
lines.zh: ：我……看得出来。

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover43
: You have a problem with Sensei sleeping in here, Chika?
lines.zh: ：你对 Sensei 睡在这儿有意见吗，Chika？

lines.en: : I mean...I don’t have a {i}problem{/i} with it.
lines.zh: ：我是说……我{i}没意见{/i}。

lines.en: : I just think it’s a little immature to not let a grown man choose for himself.
lines.zh: ：我只是觉得，不让一个成年男人自己选，有点幼稚。

lines.en: : Hmm.
scene floor1sleepover44
: I think you should mind your own business.
lines.zh: ：我觉得你还是管好自己的事吧。

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover45
: Excuse me?
lines.zh: ：你说什么？

lines.en: : Why are you assuming that we’re forcing Sensei to stay in here when it’s exactly where he would have chosen to sleep no matter {i}who{/i} was inside?
lines.zh: ：你凭什么觉得我们是在强迫 Sensei 待在这儿？不管里面是{i}谁{/i}，他本来就会选这儿睡啊。

lines.en: : You don’t know him as well as we do, so allow me to inform you that Sensei couldn’t care less about which girls are in here. He just hates sleeping on the floor.
lines.zh: ：你没我们了解他，那就让我告诉你吧：Sensei 根本不在乎房间里是哪个女生。他只是讨厌睡地板。

lines.en: : Which is exactly why Ayane and I were so adamant about getting the bed.
lines.zh: ：所以我和 Ayane 才这么坚持要抢到床。

lines.en: : Just seems a little weird for his {i}[niece]{/i} to be so adamant about sleeping next to him.
lines.zh: ：他的{i}[niece]{/i}这么坚持要睡在他旁边，总觉得有点奇怪。

lines.en: : I don’t care how weird it seems. That’s just how things are.
lines.zh: ：不管看起来多奇怪我都不在乎。事情本来就是这样。

lines.en: : It’s nothing against you, of course. But I kinda need this right now.
lines.zh: ：当然，我不是针对你。只是我现在有点需要这样。

lines.en: : You “kind of need him” all the time.
lines.zh: ：你「一直都有点需要他」。

lines.en: : Yup! Now you’re starting to get it.
lines.zh: ：没错！你开始懂了。

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover46
: You’re really going to sleep in here?
lines.zh: ：你真的要睡在这儿？

lines.en: : Well...this {i}is{/i} where the bed is...
lines.zh: ：嗯……床在这儿嘛……

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover47
: Hmph. Fine.
lines.zh: ：哼。行吧。

lines.en: : Woo! The SLS wins its first battle!
lines.zh: ：哇哦！SLS 赢得了第一场战斗！

lines.en: : With many, many more sure to come.
lines.zh: ：接下来还会有很多很多场。

lines.en: : I feel like you two could have been a {i}little{/i} bit nicer...
lines.zh: ：我觉得你们两个本来可以再友善{i}一点{/i}的……

lines.en: scene black
: Probably! But you’re all ours now.
lines.zh: ：大概吧！不过现在你完全属于我们了。

lines.en: : Ami! Attack!
lines.zh: ：Ami！上！

lines.en: : On it!
lines.zh: ：收到！

lines.en: : What do you mean “attack?” I’m a willing participant-
lines.zh: ：「上」是什么意思？我可是自愿参与的——

lines.en: I am ruthlessly tackled onto the bed and pinned down by my shoulders as Ami and Ayane climb on top of me.
lines.zh: 我被毫不留情地扑倒在床上，肩膀被按住，Ami 和 Ayane 爬到了我身上。

lines.en: The inevitable erection I alluded to earlier finally begins to come into existence and I do everything in my power to fight it off for as long as I can...
lines.zh: 我之前提到的那场不可避免的勃起终于开始成形，我使出浑身解数，尽可能久地把它压下去……

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover48
: Now...where were we?
lines.zh: ：那么……我们刚才说到哪儿了？

lines.en: : The inn...surrounded by all of your friends...right outside of an open door.
lines.zh: ：在旅馆里……被你所有的朋友包围着……就在敞开的门外。

lines.en: : Sensei! Are you insinuating that Ami and I were about to do something NSFW?
lines.zh: ：Sensei！你是在暗示我和 Ami 准备做点「少儿不宜」的事吗？

lines.en: : Because that wasn’t the idea, but I guess I could be convinced as long as you pay more attention to me than her.
lines.zh: ：因为我本来没这个打算，不过只要你多关注我一点、少关注她一点，我想我还是可以被说服的。

lines.en: if amifingered == False:
: It’s not like he pays enough attention to me in the first place.
lines.zh: ：反正他本来也没怎么关注我。

lines.en: : If Ayane being here is what it takes to change that, fine. So be it.
lines.zh: ：如果 Ayane 在这儿能改变这一点，那行吧。就这样吧。

lines.en: Slowly but surely, I can feel my mind beginning to consume my body.
lines.zh: 缓慢却确定无疑地，我能感觉到我的理智开始吞噬我的身体。

lines.en: I can not fight this off much longer.
lines.zh: 我撑不了多久了。

lines.en: : You know...I thought I’d have an easier time falling asleep tonight...
lines.zh: ：你知道吗……我本来以为今晚我会很容易就睡着……

lines.en: : But maybe it will be the exact opposite?
lines.zh: ：但也许结果会完全相反？

lines.en: : I know what you mean, Ami. But I’m going to go ahead and ignore that you feel the same way because you two are still related and your babies wouldn’t be as cute as mine.
lines.zh: ：我懂你的意思，Ami。不过我打算当你没说过——因为你俩毕竟还有血缘关系，而且你们的孩子不会像我的那么可爱。

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover49
: I’m sorry, what was that, Ayane?
lines.zh: ：抱歉，你刚才说什么，Ayane？

lines.en: : I couldn’t hear you over the sound of your...stupid face.
lines.zh: ：你那张……蠢脸太吵了，我没听清。

lines.en: : Ami, come on. I raised you better than that.
lines.zh: ：Ami，别这样。我把你教得比这好。

lines.en: : I think.
lines.zh: ：大概吧。

lines.en: scene floor1sleepover50
: Love me.
lines.zh: ：爱我。

lines.en: : Love me...
lines.zh: ：爱我……

: What?! No! You’re too pretty! It won’t be fair to us!

lines.zh: ：我倒不反对……但你大概得睡在——

lines.en: As such, I spend all of my time participating in conversations as they are delivered to me, and ultimately fall asleep with two tiny love machines strapped to my body.

lines.en: It’s exhausting at first, sure...

lines.en: The good thing about this is that it means I won’t be going to sleep in jeans tonight.

lines.en: But hey, all of the residents of the second floor are pretty chill.

lines.en: You know what? I’m not going to think about how normal anyone is right now.

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover1
I make my way into the room with a pep in my step and a dream in my heart.
lines.zh: 我脚步轻快、心怀梦想地走进了房间。

lines.en: Tonight is the night I have sex with eleven girls at once.
lines.zh: 今晚就是我一次性跟十一个女生上床的夜晚。

lines.en: I take a look around the room to find everyone essentially doing their own thing and am quickly hit with my first dilemma out of what I imagine will be many.
lines.zh: 我环顾房间，发现大家基本上都在各忙各的，很快就迎来了我想象中诸多难题里的第一个。

lines.en: Who am I going to talk to first?
lines.zh: 我要先跟谁说话？

lines.en: We have all night, so I’m sure I’ll be able to spend at least a {i}little{/i} time with everyone, but...
lines.zh: 我们有一整晚的时间，所以我相信至少能跟每个人待上{i}一小会儿{/i}，不过……

lines.en: Well...I guess there’d be even less use in standing around. So I should probably just make a decision now.
lines.zh: 嗯……我想干站着就更没意义了。所以我大概该现在就做个决定。

lines.en: Who do I want to talk to?
lines.zh: 我想跟谁说话？

lines.en: menu floor2sleepovermenu:
Karin & Kirin
lines.zh: Karin 和 Kirin

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover2
I make my way over to the Kanda sisters to see how Karin mysteriously wound up reconciling with Kirin over the last several hours.
lines.zh: 我走向 Kanda 姐妹，想看看 Karin 是怎么在过去几个小时里神奇地和 Kirin 和好的。

lines.en: : Umm...hey!
: Sup?
lines.zh: ：咋了？

lines.en: : Hey. Just figured I’d see what you two were up to on account of the whole “me sleeping in here” thing.
lines.zh: ：嘿。我就是来看看你们两个在忙什么，毕竟有「我睡在这儿」这回事。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, what was that?
lines.zh: ：抱歉，你刚才说什么？

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover3
: Remember that dorm war thing we had you judge a while ago?
lines.zh: ：还记得之前那场让你当裁判的宿舍大战吗？

lines.en: : I remember you licking Miku.
lines.zh: ：我记得你舔了 Miku。

lines.en: : Yeah, that one.
lines.zh: ：对，就是那次。

lines.en: : Sensei was the prize for that. And since we won, he has to sleep in our room.
lines.zh: ：Sensei 是那次的奖品。既然我们赢了，他就得睡在我们房间。

lines.en: : But...
lines.zh: ：可是……

lines.en: : But then where will all of you sleep?
lines.zh: ：那你们大家睡哪儿？

lines.en: : Probs on top of him or something. I don’t know.
lines.zh: ：大概压在他身上什么的吧。我也不知道。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover4
: But...there are so many of you!
lines.zh: ：可是……你们人这么多！

lines.en: : Surely he’ll suffocate!
lines.zh: ：他肯定会窒息的！

lines.en: : Hey, if that’s the way I’m meant to go, so be it.
lines.zh: ：嘿，如果那就是我注定的死法，那就这样吧。

lines.en: : Yeah, I was about to say. I don’t think he’d mind.
lines.zh: ：对，我也正要说。我觉得他不会介意的。

lines.en: : That aside, what’s going on with you two?
lines.zh: ：先不说这个，你们两个怎么回事？

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover5
: Hm? What’re you talking about?
lines.zh: ：嗯？你在说什么？

lines.en: : I mean...didn’t today start off with you being mad at Karin for coming to the beach when you told her not to?
lines.zh: ：我是说……今天一开始，你不是还在生 Karin 的气吗，因为她不听你的话跑来海滩了？

lines.en: : Ahh. Yeah, I guess the morning did start like that.
lines.zh: ：啊。对，早上确实是这样开的头。

lines.en: : We’re fine now, though.
lines.zh: ：不过我们现在没事了。

lines.en: : Kirin and I are...about to go night swimming.
lines.zh: ：我和 Kirin 正准备……去夜游。

lines.en: : Having a sister sounds exhausting. That’s too dramatic a change for only several hours passing by.
lines.zh: ：有个姐姐听起来真累。才过了几个小时，变化也太大了吧。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover6
: Well, hey! A certain somebody and {i}another{/i} certain {i}female{/i} somebody really helped me get over it earlier.
lines.zh: ：话说回来！某个某人和{i}另一个{/i}某个{i}女生{/i}真的帮我走出来了。

lines.en: : A certain somebody and...a female somebody that...Wait, what?
lines.zh: ：某个某人和……某个女生，那个……等等，什么？

lines.en: : I don’t understand what you just said.
lines.zh: ：我没听懂你刚才说的话。

lines.en: : And you don’t have to worry about it, Karin! Thanks for agreeing to stay out of it!
lines.zh: ：你不用担心这个，Karin！谢谢你答应不掺和！

lines.en: : But then...why would you-
lines.zh: ：可是……那你为什么——

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover8
: Anyway, did you wanna come swimming with us?
lines.zh: ：总之，你想跟我们一起去游泳吗？

lines.en: : We’re both pretty good, but we can pretend we’re not and you could give us lessons or something.
lines.zh: ：我们俩都游得挺好，但我们可以假装不会，然后你给我们上上课什么的。

lines.en: : I think that sounds like a load of fun, don’t you, sis?
lines.zh: ：我觉得这听起来超好玩的，对吧，老妹？

lines.en: : I’ll just...close my eyes while he teaches you, so...I don’t get jealous.
lines.zh: ：他教你的时候我就……闭上眼睛，这样……我就不会嫉妒了。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover9
: Ah! Did I say jealous?! I meant...jelly!
lines.zh: ：啊！我刚说嫉妒了吗？！我是想说……果冻！

lines.en: : Jellyfish! That’s what I was trying to say!
lines.zh: ：水母！我想说的是水母！

lines.en: : I can’t get swimming lessons because of my...jellyfish allergy!
lines.zh: ：我不能上游泳课，因为我对……水母过敏！

lines.en: : Oh? I guess more Sensei for me then.
lines.zh: ：哦？那 Sensei 就归我一个人了。

lines.en: : As fun as that sounds, I don’t really think I’m allowed to leave the room.
lines.zh: ：虽然听起来很有意思，但我觉得我大概不能离开房间。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover10
: You’re {i}allowed{/i} to do whatever you want. You’re a grown man.
lines.zh: ：你想干什么{i}都行{/i}。你是个成年男人了。

lines.en: : You’re...really not coming?
lines.zh: ：你……真的不来吗？

lines.en: : Karin, literally two seconds ago you were telling us that you couldn’t even swim because of your alleged jellyfish allergy.
lines.zh: ：Karin，两秒钟前你才刚跟我们说，因为你那个所谓的水母过敏，你连游泳都不行。

lines.en: : I wasn’t sad two seconds ago...now I am.
lines.zh: ：两秒钟前我还没难过……现在我难过了。

lines.en: : Well, if I’m still awake when you guys get back, feel free to come...tell me about it or whatever.
lines.zh: ：那好吧，等你们回来的时候要是我还没睡，随时来……跟我说说之类的。

lines.en: : Laaaaaame.
: Okay...
lines.zh: ：好吧……

lines.en: : Goodnight, Sensei...
lines.zh: ：晚安，Sensei……

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover11
: Hey, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: ：嘿，Tsuneyo。

lines.en: : Sup, bro?
lines.zh: ：咋了，兄弟？

lines.en: : Why are you still saying that?
lines.zh: ：你怎么还在说这个？

lines.en: : It is an important greeting I have learned. And once I learn something, I am incapable of forgetting it.
lines.zh: ：这是我学会的一个重要问候语。而一旦我学会了什么，就无法忘记。

lines.en: : Also, your son is here. You two need to stop fighting. It is tearing our family apart.
lines.zh: ：另外，你儿子在这儿。你们两个别再吵了。这正在拆散我们的家庭。

lines.en: : My son?
lines.zh: ：我儿子？

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover12
: I can’t believe I ever married you.
lines.zh: ：我真不敢相信自己居然嫁过你。

lines.en: : Probably because you didn’t.
lines.zh: ：大概因为你根本没嫁过。

lines.en: : I am referring to Noodles.
lines.zh: ：我说的是 Noodles。

lines.en: : Yeah, what else is new?
lines.zh: ：是啊，又来了。

lines.en: : Noodles the bird.
lines.zh: ：Noodles 那只鸟。

lines.en: : The one who carries the knife and says all that existential stuff?
lines.zh: ：那只带着刀、满口存在主义的那只？

lines.en: : This is why you two always fight. You refuse to understand one another.
lines.zh: ：这就是你们两个总吵架的原因。你们拒绝去理解彼此。

lines.en: : Tsuneyo, I haven’t “talked” to that bird since we decided to name him.
lines.zh: ：Tsuneyo，自从我们决定给他起名字之后，我就再没跟那只鸟「说过话」了。

lines.en: : Dear God, it’s even worse than I thought.
lines.zh: ：天哪，比我想的还糟。

lines.en: : Can we stop talking about birds for a second? I am spending my extremely valuable time during this sleepover talking to you and I would appreciate it if the conversation would at least be...good.
lines.zh: ：我们能先别聊鸟吗？我在这场睡衣派对里极其宝贵的时间正花在跟你说话上，如果这对话至少能……有点质量，我会很感激。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover11
: I am afraid you have come to the wrong person if that is what you are after.
lines.zh: ：恐怕你要是这个目的，就找错人了。

lines.en: : One of the many things I have learned from the other girls in this room is that I am not very good at socializing.
lines.zh: ：我从这个房间里其他女生身上学到的诸多事情之一就是，我不太擅长社交。

lines.en: : The Green Onion wants me to get better at facial expressions, but they seem very difficult.
lines.zh: ：青葱希望我把面部表情练好，但那看起来太难了。

lines.en: : Yeah, I never really got the hang of those either.
lines.zh: ：是啊，我也一直没搞懂那玩意儿。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover13
: Of course. That explains why I never enjoy talking to you.
lines.zh: ：当然。这就解释了为什么我从来都不喜欢跟你说话。

lines.en: : So, anyway, is Molly already asleep?
lines.zh: ：那么，总之，Molly 已经睡了吗？

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover14
: The Emerald Guardian had a...difficult night.
lines.zh: ：翡翠守护者经历了……一个艰难的夜晚。

lines.en: : She is currently recovering her mana so she can start anew in the morning.
lines.zh: ：她目前正在恢复法力，好在早晨重新开始。

lines.en: : Did something happen?
lines.zh: ：出什么事了吗？

lines.en: : A disagreement of sorts regarding the one the Guardian refers to as a “Succubus.”
lines.zh: ：是关于那位被守护者称作「魅魔」的人，发生了一些争执。

lines.en: : I don’t really know what that means, but I can probably guess who she’s referring to based on...past experiences.
lines.zh: ：我不太明白那是什么意思，不过根据……以往的经验，我大概能猜出她说的是谁。

lines.en: : I worry about her, Supreme Overlord Horrible Father.
lines.zh: ：我很担心她，至高无上的糟糕父亲大人。

lines.en: : That’s definitely one of my worst nicknames, not going to lie.
lines.zh: ：说实话，这绝对是我最难听的外号之一。

lines.en: : You have helped me prepare for loss, but I have not yet studied the means of becoming a better friend.
lines.zh: ：你曾帮我为失去做好准备，但我还没有学过如何成为一个更好的朋友。

lines.en: : What can I do to restore her mana quicker?
lines.zh: ：我要怎么做，才能让她更快恢复法力？

lines.en: : I know one way that she’s told me about before, but I don’t really know if either of you would find it particularly-
lines.zh: ：我知道一个她以前跟我说过的办法，不过我不太确定你们俩会不会觉得它特别——

lines.en: : Actually, you both probably would.
lines.zh: ：其实，你们俩大概都会。

lines.en: : But I still shouldn’t tell you.
lines.zh: ：但我还是不该告诉你们。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover13
: Darn it.
lines.zh: ：可恶。

lines.en: : It appears that I will simply remain by her side in the event that she needs anything.
lines.zh: ：看来我只能守在她身边，以备她有什么需要了。

lines.en: : Honestly, that’s kind of what a good friend would do anyway. My thing was a lot more, uhh...physical.
lines.zh: ：说实话，那本来就是一个好朋友会做的事。我的办法要……呃……身体力行得多。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover11
: If you are referring to a “hug,” I have already tried.
lines.zh: ：如果你说的是「拥抱」，我已经试过了。

lines.en: : I’m not.
lines.zh: ：不是。

lines.en: : But anyway, it’s been real. I think I’m going to go talk to a few of the others now.
lines.zh: ：不过总之，聊得很开心。我想我现在要去找其他几个人聊聊了。

lines.en: : I understand and apologize for making things awkward.
lines.zh: ：我明白，也很抱歉把气氛弄得很尴尬。

lines.en: : You actually kind of didn’t this time, as weird as that sounds.
lines.zh: ：虽然听起来很奇怪，但这次你其实没怎么弄尴尬。

lines.en: : You are just saying that to make me feel better. I make everything awkward.
lines.zh: ：你这么说只是为了让我好受点。我把一切都弄得尴尬。

lines.en: : Okay, now it’s awkward.
lines.zh: ：好吧，现在尴尬了。

lines.en: : Peace out, bro.
lines.zh: ：走了，兄弟。

lines.en: : Bye, Tsuneyo.
lines.zh: ：再见，Tsuneyo。

lines.zh: 而我想，既然她看起来已经睡着了，那我今晚剩下的计划就是尽可能久地继续盯着看了。

lines.en: I probably shouldn’t have worn sweatpants.

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover16
: May I help you with something?
lines.zh: ：有什么事需要我帮忙吗？

lines.en: : Why aren’t you excited to be sleeping in the same room as me?
lines.zh: ：你为什么对能和我睡在同一个房间一点也不兴奋？

lines.en: : Because it’s entirely inappropriate...but that is not the reason for my foul mood.
lines.zh: ：因为那完全不合时宜……不过那不是我心情不好的原因。

lines.zh: ：这床被褥薄得像纸。我能感觉到自己的背直接透过它压在地板上。

lines.en: : I’m almost certain I’m going to have to visit the chiropractor as soon as we return home.
lines.zh: ：我几乎可以肯定，一回家就得去看脊椎按摩师了。

lines.en: : To be fair, I’m surprised you don’t already have to visit one on a regular basis.
lines.zh: ：说句公道话，我很惊讶你居然不是已经要定期去看了。

lines.en: : Get it? Because-
lines.zh: ：懂了吗？因为——

lines.en: : Yes.
lines.zh: ：懂了。

lines.en: : And, might I add, {i}that{/i} was entirely inappropriate as well.
lines.zh: ：而且我得说，{i}那样说{/i}也完全不合时宜。

lines.en: : Sorry. I just figured it was okay since we’ve been on a date before.
lines.zh: ：抱歉。我只是觉得没关系，毕竟我们以前约过会。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover17
: Wha-
: Must I inform you again that that {i}wasn’t{/i} a real date? I was only involved in that contest because of reasons completely out of my control.
lines.zh: ：我必须再告诉你一次吗，那{i}不是{/i}真正的约会？我之所以参加那个比赛，完全是出于我无法控制的原因。

lines.en: : Yeah, yeah. You wanted the athletics or knowledge thing instead. I remember.
lines.zh: ：是是是。你本来想参加体育或者知识类的。我记得。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover18
: Hah...maybe next year, I suppose.
lines.zh: ：哈……大概明年吧，我想。

lines.en: : Speaking of next year, I’m also hoping for a repeat of your little bonus contest. That was one of the highlights of the whole weekend.
lines.zh: ：说到明年，我还希望能再来一次你那个小小的加时赛。那是整个周末最精彩的部分之一。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover19
: Bonus contest? Whatever are you talking about?
lines.zh: ：加时赛？你到底在说什么？

lines.en: : Nothing at all, Touka.
lines.zh: ：没什么，Touka。

lines.en: : {i}Nothing at all...{/i}
lines.zh: {i}：真的没什么……{/i}

lines.en: : And there you go with that horrid whispering again. I don’t understand how hard it is to just lower your voice to an inaudible level.
lines.zh: ：你又来那套讨厌的低声嘀咕了。我真不懂把声音压到听不见有那么难吗。

lines.en: : But I suppose that doesn’t matter.
lines.zh: ：不过我想那也不重要了。

lines.en: Note to self: encourage Touka to drink more.
lines.zh: 备忘：多劝 Touka 喝点酒。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover20
: So, is this how you’re going to spend your night?
lines.zh: ：那么，你今晚就这么过了？

lines.en: : Talking to me out of pity because I’m all alone?
lines.zh: ：因为我孤零零一个人，所以出于同情来陪我说话？

lines.en: : It’s not out of pity. I came over here because I actually {i}wanted{/i} to talk to you.
lines.zh: ：不是出于同情。我过来是因为我真的{i}想{/i}跟你说话。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover21
: Sensei...
lines.zh: ：Sensei……

lines.en: : Do you...do you really mean that?
lines.zh: ：你……你真的是这么想的吗？

lines.en: : Of course. You’re one of my favorite students, Tomoko.
lines.zh: ：当然。你是我最喜欢的学生之一，Tomoko。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover15
: Goodnight.
lines.zh: ：晚安。

lines.en: : Oh, come on. That was hilarious.
lines.zh: ：哦，拜托。那很好笑啊。

lines.en: : The first time? Maybe. The second time? Okay.
lines.zh: ：第一次？也许吧。第二次？还行。

lines.en: : But you have now referred to me by the incorrect name roughly one hundred separate times and I am becoming exhausted from tricking myself into thinking you’ll drop those petty games of yours.
lines.zh: ：可你现在已经叫错我的名字大概一百次了，我已经懒得再骗自己相信你会放下你那些无聊的小把戏了。

lines.en: : I’m beginning to feel my chances of marrying into the Tsukioka family slip away.
lines.zh: ：我开始觉得自己入赘 Tsukioka 家的机会在一点点溜走了。

lines.en: : I still have a mother and younger sister. Perhaps you’ll find yourself tormenting one of them instead of me one of these days?
lines.zh: ：我还有母亲和妹妹。说不定哪天你会发现自己跑去折磨她们，而不是我了？

lines.en: : I have a creeping suspicion that I will be doing just that eventually, yes.
lines.zh: ：我有种越来越强烈的预感，我迟早会那么干的，没错。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover22
: I suppose we’ll be putting up with each other for quite some time then, won’t we?
lines.zh: ：看来我们还要互相忍受很长一段时间呢，是吧？

lines.en: : You don’t know the half of it.
lines.zh: ：你才知道一半呢。

lines.en: : I...wouldn’t mind listening if you wanted to-
lines.zh: ：我……不介意听你说，如果你想——

lines.en: : Anyway, it’s been fun, but I’m going to go mingle with some of the other girls now.
lines.zh: ：总之，聊得很开心，不过我现在要去跟其他几个女生混一混了。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover17
: Wait...already? But you just got here!
lines.zh: ：等等……这就走了？你才刚来啊！

lines.en: : Yeah, but there are ten of you. I have to distribute my time evenly.
lines.zh: ：是啊，可你们有十个人。我得把时间平均分配。

lines.en: : Well...okay, then...
: Good...goodnight?
lines.zh: ：晚……晚安？

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover23
: Hey, Otoha. What are you up to over- woah.
lines.zh: ：嘿，Otoha。你在那边忙什么呢——哇哦。

lines.en: : Have I told you lately how much I like your pajamas?
lines.zh: ：我最近有没有跟你说过，我有多喜欢你的睡衣？

lines.en: : Because I really like them.
lines.zh: ：因为我真的很喜欢。

lines.en: : Like, a lot.
lines.zh: ：非常喜欢。

lines.en: : You should stop wearing other clothes altogether and just only wear those from now on.
lines.zh: ：你以后干脆别穿别的衣服了，只穿这个就行。

lines.en: : Hey, Otoha. If you want me to touch you, stay silent.
lines.zh: ：嘿，Otoha。如果你想让我碰你，就保持沉默。

lines.en: : Welp, guess I’ll just-
lines.zh: ：好吧，看来我只能——

lines.en: : Not so fast, Sensei.
lines.zh: ：别急，Sensei。

lines.en: : I’ve sworn to protect Otoha from predators while she is “in the zone,” so to speak.
lines.zh: ：我发过誓，要在 Otoha「进入状态」的时候保护她不受捕食者侵害，可以这么说。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover24
Noriko
lines.zh: Noriko

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover28
: Hey, Noriko.
lines.zh: ：嘿，Noriko。

lines.en: : Hi, Sensei.
lines.zh: ：嗨，Sensei。

lines.en: : Can you pinch me please?
lines.zh: ：你能掐我一下吗？

lines.en: : Like, in a sexual way?
lines.zh: ：你是说，带点性意味的那种？

lines.en: : Like, in a “I think I’m actually dreaming” kind of way. But it can be sexual too if you want. I’m down with a little bit of pain.
lines.zh: ：就是「我觉得我在做梦」的那种。不过你想带点性意味也行。一点点疼痛我没问题。

lines.en: : I am somehow not surprised by this.
lines.zh: ：不知怎的，我一点也不惊讶。

lines.en: : Why aren’t you hanging out with any of the other girls? I had the feeling that you were starting to get kind of popular with them.
lines.zh: ：你怎么没跟其他女生一起玩？我总觉得你在她们中间开始有点人气了。

lines.en: : Because I was waiting for you, obviously.
lines.zh: ：因为我一直在等你啊，很明显。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover29
: We haven’t had a sleepover since I was still really little, so I’m kind of...really excited and stuff.
lines.zh: ：从我还在很小的时候起，我们就没再一起过夜了，所以我有点……特别兴奋什么的。

lines.en: : You know we can sleep together whenever you want, right?
lines.zh: ：你知道你想的话，我们随时都能一起睡吧？

lines.en: : No, we can’t. Not with Maya basically living at your house and Kirin always trying to put your dick in her mouth.
lines.zh: ：不，我们不行。Maya 基本上住在你家，Kirin 又总想把你的鸡巴塞进她嘴里。

lines.en: : Well...
: Other places exist?
lines.zh: ：别的地方也是存在的吧？

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover30
: Yeah...there are plenty of other places that exist. And any one of them would be fine so long as we’re together.
lines.zh: ：是啊……别的地方多得是。只要我们在一块儿，任何地方都行。

lines.en: Noriko begins to pick at a loose string on one of the kneecaps of her pajama pants.
lines.zh: Noriko 开始抠她睡裤膝盖处一根松脱的线头。

lines.en: I notice her hands trembling slightly, which is a little surprising given that all we’re doing right now is talking.
lines.zh: 我注意到她的手在微微发抖，考虑到我们现在只是在说话，这有点让人意外。

lines.en: : Um...do you mind if I ask you a question?
lines.zh: ：嗯……我能问你个问题吗？

lines.en: : Not really, no. Go ahead.
lines.zh: ：不介意，问吧。

lines.en: : Rhetorically, if I just so happened to convince the rest of the girls to let me have you tonight and that you had to sleep in the futon with me...how would that make you feel?
lines.zh: ：假设性地问一句，如果我刚好说服了其他女生，让她们今晚把你让给我，而你不得不跟我一起睡在被褥里……你会有什么感觉？

lines.en: : This isn’t rhetorical, is it?
lines.zh: ：这不是假设，对吧？

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover31
: Will you think I’m crazy if I say no?
lines.zh: ：如果我说不是，你会觉得我疯了吗？

lines.en: : I already kind of think you’re crazy. But not because of this.
lines.zh: ：我本来就有点觉得你疯了。但不是因为这个。

lines.en: : If anything, I’m more surprised you were {i}able{/i} to convince them.
lines.zh: ：要说的话，我更惊讶的是你{i}居然{/i}说服了她们。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover32
: It probably never would have worked if I wasn’t on the second floor. There’s no way Ami or Ayane or...anyone else down there would have accepted this.
lines.zh: ：如果我不是在二楼，这事大概根本成不了。楼下的 Ami、Ayane 或者……其他任何人，都不可能接受这种事。

lines.en: : But...all of the girls on the second floor are kind of playing this big...strategy game with one another and waiting to see what everyone else does.
lines.zh: ：不过……二楼的女生都在玩一场很大的……策略游戏，互相盯着看别人怎么走。

lines.en: : I just got tired of waiting and wanted to feel like I did when I was younger for a little while tonight.
lines.zh: ：我只是等烦了，今晚想找回一点小时候的那种感觉。

lines.en: : Why are you crying, though? You got what you wanted.
lines.zh: ：可你为什么在哭？你得到了你想要的啊。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover33
: They’re happy tears. I think. Probably.
lines.zh: ：这是开心的眼泪。我想。大概吧。

lines.en: : I don’t know. I don’t really cry that much.
lines.zh: ：我也不知道。我其实不太爱哭。

lines.en: : I’m just feeling a lot of things right now and...thinking of how far this has all come.
lines.zh: ：我现在只是感触很多，而且……在想这一切都走了多远。

lines.en: : It’s still kind of surreal that I can even look at you again. I guess it’s just not...done sinking in yet.
lines.zh: ：我居然还能再看着你，这件事到现在还有点不真实。我想它大概……还没完全沉淀下来。

lines.en: : Well...stop. I don’t like crying.
lines.zh: ：那个……别哭了。我不喜欢哭。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover28
: Okay! Done!
lines.zh: ：好！不哭了！

lines.en: : Really? That easily?
lines.zh: ：真的？这么容易？

lines.en: : Yup!
: Bark like a dog.
lines.zh: ：学狗叫。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover34
: Arf!
: Now meow like a cat.
lines.zh: ：再学猫叫。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover35
: Nyaa~
: Now say something sexy.
lines.zh: ：现在说点性感的话。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover36
: This one time, I hid in the closet while you were fingering my sister and had to hold my mouth closed so you wouldn’t hear me moan from playing with myself.
lines.zh: ：有一次，你用手指弄我妹妹的时候，我躲在衣柜里，还得捂住自己的嘴，免得你听见我自己在玩的时候发出的呻吟。

lines.en: : Okay, maybe it wasn’t just one time. Maybe it was a few.
lines.zh: ：好吧，也许不止一次。也许有几次。

lines.en: : Maybe it was a lot.
lines.zh: ：也许有很多次。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover37
: I was a growing girl, okay?! I found a thing that felt good and I kept doing it! Sue me!
lines.zh: ：我当时正在长身体，好吗？！我找到了一件感觉很好的事，就一直做了下去！你要告我就告啊！

lines.en: : If anything, I’m just surprised Niki never found out.
lines.zh: ：要说的话，我只是惊讶 Niki 居然从来没发现。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover38
: She found out, didn’t she?
lines.zh: ：她发现了，对吧？

lines.en: : I...think I managed to convince her I was just trying on her clothes? But I’m still kind of embarrassed about it and bringing up that part evokes some really cringey memories.
lines.zh: ：我……好像成功让她相信我只是在试她的衣服？不过我现在还是有点难为情，一提起来就会想起一些特别尴尬的回忆。

lines.en: : Well, on that note, I think I’m going to talk to a few more of the girls before...apparently returning to you and sleeping in your futon.
lines.zh: ：嗯，说到这个，我想我得再去跟其他几个女生聊聊，然后……显然是回到你这儿，睡在你的被褥里。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover28
: Okay!
lines.zh: ：好的！

lines.en: : Don’t miss me as much as I’ll miss you, because the pain would probably cause your head to explode into a million pieces and I don’t want to turn into Jackie Kennedy tonight.
lines.zh: ：你可别想我想得跟我想你一样厉害，因为那种痛苦大概会让你的头炸成上百万片，而我今晚可不想变成 Jackie Kennedy。

lines.en: : ...Got it.
lines.zh: ：……明白了。

I notice Uta and Io out of the corner of my eye and make my way into the bedroom to see what they’re up to.
lines.zh: 我用余光注意到 Uta 和 Io，于是走进卧室看看她们在干什么。

lines.en: However, immediately upon entering the room, I find that their mood doesn’t really match the rest of the inn...
lines.zh: 然而一进房间，我就发现她们的氛围和旅馆里其他地方不太一样……

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover39
: Uhhhhh hey, Sensei! Don’t mind us, just...tryin’ to figure out what the heck is goin’ on in here.
lines.zh: ：呃呃呃嘿，Sensei！别管我们，我们只是……在想这屋里到底是怎么回事。

lines.en: : What do you mean?
lines.zh: ：什么意思？

lines.en: : She means that Yasu’s been just...staring at the wall for like twenty minutes and not moving.
lines.zh: ：她的意思是，Yasu 就那么……盯着墙看了二十分钟，一动不动。

lines.en: : Oh. Yeah, she does that.
lines.zh: ：哦。对，她经常这样。

lines.en: : Do you...do you know why?
lines.zh: ：你……你知道为什么吗？

lines.en: : I think it’s how she prays? I don’t know. I try not to get too wrapped up in religion.
lines.zh: ：我觉得那是她祈祷的方式？我也不知道。我尽量不让自己陷进宗教里。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover40
: Should we like...do anything?
lines.zh: ：我们要不要……做点什么？

lines.en: : I brought some of my pills. Do you think maybe if we just throw a bunch of them at her, one might work?
lines.zh: ：我带了一些我的药。你觉得要是我们冲她扔一大把，会不会有一片管用？

lines.en: : I think she’d need to ingest them, but sure. It’s worth a shot.
lines.zh: ：我觉得她得吃下去才行，不过行吧。值得一试。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover41
: Io! You can’t just throw a bunch of different medications at somebody and hope one works!
lines.zh: ：Io！你不能把一堆不同的药往别人身上扔，然后指望有一片管用！

lines.en: : Why not? That’s basically what all of the the[rapist]s did for me and I turned out-
lines.zh: ：为什么不行？那些 the[rapist]s 对我干的基本就是这套，而我后来——

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover42
: Oh.
: Shit.
: Yeah, okay. I get it now.
lines.zh: ：好吧，行。我现在懂了。

lines.en: : Sensei, I don’t know how I’m gonna fall asleep if she’s in here with us. She’s kinda creepin’ me out.
lines.zh: ：Sensei，她在这儿的话，我不知道我怎么睡得着。她有点吓到我。

lines.en: : Again, yeah. She does that.
lines.zh: ：再说一遍，对，她经常这样。

lines.en: : But, on the topic of sleep...did you guys really agree to surrender me to Noriko?
lines.zh: ：不过，说到睡觉……你们真的同意把我让给 Noriko 了？

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover43
: {i}I{/i} didn’t. I wanted you in here with Uta and me so I wouldn’t feel pressured to go out there to see you.
lines.zh: ：{i}我{/i}不同意。我想让你和 Uta、我一起待在这儿，这样我就不用被迫出去找你了。

lines.en: : But Uta decided for whatever reason to go along with it. And everyone else basically followed suit after that and just...let it happen.
lines.zh: ：可 Uta 不知道为什么就同意了。其他人在那之后也都跟着附和，就那么……任其发生了。

lines.en: : I just figured...that we’d be staying up really late and that...it wouldn’t matter if it was just the sleepin’ part...
lines.zh: ：我只是觉得……我们会熬到很晚，而且……如果只是睡觉那部分的话，也没什么关系……

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover44
: It’s whatever...I’ll just wait until tomorrow night and sneak into his room then or something.
lines.zh: ：无所谓啦……我就等明天晚上，然后偷偷溜进他房间之类的。

lines.en: Well, I’m glad the Noriko thing didn’t get Io down, at least.
lines.zh: 至少，我很高兴 Noriko 这事没让 Io 太失落。

lines.en: : You’re not...upset about this, are you?
lines.zh: ：你……没有生气吧？

lines.en: : I know the whole thing with the sleepover was that we were gonna share you, but like...we still {i}are{/i} sharing you, ya know?
lines.zh: ：我知道这次过夜的重点是我们本来要一起分享你，可是……我们现在{i}还是在{/i}分享你啊，你懂吧？

lines.en: : Just...when the lights go out...
lines.zh: ：只是……等灯灭了之后……

lines.en: : You'll be with her...
lines.zh: ：你会跟她在一起……

lines.en: : I’m not upset at all. I was just curious about how that wound up happening because, like Noriko said, that never would have happened so easily with the first floor girls.
lines.zh: ：我一点也不生气。我只是好奇这事怎么就成了，因为就像 Noriko 说的，换成一楼的女生，这事绝不会这么容易就成。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover45
: Yeah...
lines.zh: ：是啊……

lines.en: : It probably wouldn’t have...
lines.zh: ：大概是不会……

lines.en: : We should really do something about Yasu.
lines.zh: ：我们真的得拿 Yasu 想想办法了。

lines.en: : I’ll...see what I can do...
lines.zh: ：我……尽量吧……

lines.en: scene black
scene floor2sleepover46
: Uhh...Yasu?
lines.zh: ：呃……Yasu？

lines.en: : {size=-15}It’s dark. It’s dark. It’s dark. It’s dark. It’s dark. It’s dark. It’s dark. {/size}
lines.zh: {size=-15}：好黑。好黑。好黑。好黑。好黑。好黑。好黑。{/size}

lines.en: : What’s she saying? I can’t hear her over that weird funk song blasting in the other room right now.
lines.zh: ：她在说什么？隔壁房间那首怪怪的放克歌太大声，我听不见。

lines.en: : The song is called “Sweet Vermouth,” Green Onion’s slightly greener friend.
lines.zh: ：那首歌叫《Sweet Vermouth》，青葱那稍微绿一点的朋友。

lines.en: : I don’t care what it’s called. I just want Yasu to go to sleep.
lines.zh: ：我才不管它叫什么。我只想让 Yasu 去睡觉。

lines.en: : We had a mostly normal conversation with her earlier...do you think that might have tired her out?
lines.zh: ：我们之前跟她聊得还算正常……你觉得会不会是那次把她累着了？

lines.en: : Yasu...will it help if I like...give you the light or whatever?
lines.zh: ：Yasu……如果我……把光给你什么的，会有帮助吗？

lines.en: : {size=-15}There are some things not even the light can repair.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-15}：有些东西，连光也无法修复。{/size}

lines.en: : {size=-15}He can’t see. It’s all...just nothing.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-15}：祂看不见。一切……都只是虚无。{/size}

lines.en: : Everything is already g-
lines.zh: ：一切都已经——

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover47
: Uhh...Touka?! Your roommate’s being...your roommate again!
lines.zh: ：呃……Touka？！你室友又……变成你室友了！

lines.en: : Yasu-
lines.zh: ：Yasu——

lines.en: : Ugh...that girl will be the death of me.
lines.zh: ：唉……那丫头迟早会要了我的命。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover48
: {size=-15}When the dust settles, you will find me alone on the rooftop.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-15}：当尘埃落定，你会发现我独自一人在天台上。{/size}

lines.en: : {size=-15}In the same place as always.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-15}：在和往常一样的地方。{/size}

lines.en: : And if you don’t-
lines.zh: ：而如果你没有——

lines.en: : {size=-15}If you make it there and don’t see me, I need you to-{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-15}：如果你到了那里却看不见我，我需要你——{/size}

lines.en: : Yasu. It’s time for bed.
lines.zh: ：Yasu。该睡觉了。

lines.en: : {size=-15}I need you...I need you...I need you...{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-15}：我需要你……我需要你……我需要你……{/size}

lines.en: : {size=-15}Who do I need?{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-15}：我需要谁？{/size}

lines.en: : Do you have a trick for when you need to like...break her out of stuff like this?
lines.zh: ：你需要……把她从这种状态里拉出来的时候，有什么诀窍吗？

lines.en: : I do. But it’s only 75%% effective based on my testing.
lines.zh: ：有。不过根据我的测试，成功率只有 75%%。

lines.en: : That’s better than what we got! Just...give it a shot! I’m startin’ to worry.
lines.zh: ：总比我们强！就……试试看吧！我开始担心了。

lines.en: : Okay...here goes-
scene floor2sleepover49

: That’s it?
lines.zh: ：就这样？

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover50
: ...Touka?
lines.zh: ：……Touka？

lines.en: : Is everything okay? You’ve given a few of us quite the scare.
lines.zh: ：你还好吗？你把我们几个吓得不轻。

lines.en: : I’m...thirsty...
: Well, then let’s go get you a drink.
lines.zh: ：那我们去给你拿点喝的。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover51
: Can I have...a strawberry milk?
lines.zh: ：我可以要……草莓牛奶吗？

lines.en: : You can have whatever you like, Yasu. Have I told you lately about how insanely wealthy I am?
lines.zh: ：你想要什么都行，Yasu。我最近有没有跟你说过我家有多有钱？

lines.en: : Well, heck. I coulda done that.
lines.zh: ：哎呀，见鬼。这事我也能干啊。

lines.en: : I guess we...know for the future now?
lines.zh: ：我想我们……现在知道以后该怎么做了？

lines.en: scene black
I hang out with Uta and Io for a little while longer and several of the other girls begin to filter in as the night goes by.
lines.zh: 我又陪 Uta 和 Io 待了一会儿，随着夜色渐深，其他几个女生也开始陆续进来。

lines.en: Yasu and Touka return after around twenty minutes or so and Yasu seems to be completely fine.
lines.zh: Yasu 和 Touka 大约二十分钟后回来了，Yasu 看起来完全没事了。

lines.en: Well, at least by Yasu standards.
lines.zh: 至少以 Yasu 的标准来说。

lines.en: The only person who doesn’t come into the room, however, is Noriko.
lines.zh: 然而，唯一一个没进房间的人是 Noriko。

lines.en: And I don’t know if it’s pity or compassion or just flat out obligation...but I feel myself being pushed toward her the moment the lights go out...
lines.zh: 我不知道是出于怜悯、同情，还是纯粹的责任感……但灯一灭，我就感觉自己被推向了她……

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover52
: Are you really going to be the big spoon?
lines.zh: ：你真的要当大汤匙吗？

lines.en: : I like being the big spoon.
lines.zh: ：我喜欢当大汤匙。

lines.en: : But I’m like, twice your size.
lines.zh: ：可我的块头差不多是你两倍。

lines.en: : That’s why it’s fun. I’ve got so much of you to hold and rub up against that it’s like I’ll never run out.
lines.zh: ：所以才好玩啊。我有那么多的你可以抱、可以蹭，感觉永远都用不完。

lines.en: : Also, if I was the little spoon, you’d probably start humping me.
lines.zh: ：而且如果我当小汤匙，你大概会开始蹭我。

lines.en: : That does sound likely, yes.
lines.zh: ：听起来确实很有可能，没错。

lines.en: : Yeah. And it would turn into a whole thing where I’d wind up losing my virginity and being really loud and waking everybody up.
lines.zh: ：是啊。然后事情就会变成一整套流程：我会把初夜交出去，还会叫得很大声，把所有人都吵醒。

lines.en: : Unless you wanna go back to your room and-
lines.zh: ：除非你想回你自己的房间然后——

lines.en: : Noriko, shut the fuck up. I’m trying to sleep.
lines.zh: ：Noriko，闭上你他妈的嘴。我要睡觉。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover53
: No! You shut up! This is a big moment for me!
lines.zh: ：不！你才闭嘴！这对我来说是个重要的时刻！

lines.en: : You like Sensei. We get it. Can’t you just sleep quietly or whatever?
lines.zh: ：你喜欢 Sensei。我们都知道了。你能不能安静睡觉什么的？

lines.en: : Aren't you supposed to be swimming right now?!
lines.zh: ：你现在不是应该在游泳吗？！

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover52
: So anyway, where were we?
lines.zh: ：总之，我们刚才说到哪儿了？

lines.en: : Oh right. Spoons.
lines.zh: ：哦对。汤匙。

lines.en: : If you hate being the little spoon that much, just make sure you do an awesome job as the big spoon next time.
lines.zh: ：要是你这么讨厌当小汤匙，那下次当大汤匙的时候就给我好好表现。

lines.en: : And hey, who knows? Maybe I won’t have my pants on then and we'll be in a place where it's actually safe to put it in?
lines.zh: ：而且嘿，谁知道呢？也许到时候我没穿裤子，而我们又在一个真的可以安全放进去的地方？

lines.en: : That’s a horrible thing to say to someone right before going to sleep.
lines.zh: ：在别人临睡前说这种话，也太缺德了。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover54
: That’s fine.
lines.zh: ：没关系。

lines.en: : I heard that if you go to sleep hard, you’ll have sex dreams.
lines.zh: ：我听说，要是你硬着入睡，就会做春梦。

lines.en: : Besides, maybe you’ll get lucky and I’ll subconsciously reach my hand down a little too far and give you a sleep-handie or something.
lines.zh: ：再说，说不定你运气好，我会在无意识中把手伸得稍微下面一点，给你来个「睡眠手活」什么的。

lines.en: : This isn’t helping.
lines.zh: ：这可没什么帮助。

lines.en: : I love you, Sensei.
lines.zh: ：我爱你，Sensei。

lines.en: : Noriko, you-
lines.zh: ：Noriko，你——

lines.en: : Oh. Wait. That helped.
lines.zh: ：哦。等等。这个有帮助。

lines.en: : Are you telling me you got soft from hearing me say I love you?
lines.zh: ：你是说，听到我说爱你，你就软了？

lines.en: : Not soft. Just soft{i}er{/i}.
lines.zh: ：不是软了。只是{i}没那么硬{/i}了。

lines.en: : So mean.
lines.zh: ：好过分。

lines.en: : Noriko, oh my fucking God.
lines.zh: ：Noriko，我的天啊。

lines.en: scene floor2sleepover53
: FUCK OFF, KIRIN! JESUS.
lines.zh: ：滚开，KIRIN！天哪。

lines.en: scene black
Noriko makes small talk for a while longer, but I eventually find my consciousness fading.
lines.zh: Noriko 又闲聊了一会儿，但我最终感觉到意识在渐渐消退。

lines.en: It feels strange falling asleep with the arms of someone other than Ami or Ayane wrapped around me, but I guess if anyone was going to be next in line, it’s another girl I’ve known forever.
lines.zh: 被 Ami 或 Ayane 以外的人的手臂环抱着入睡，感觉很奇怪，不过我想如果真有下一个，那也是一个我认识了一辈子的女孩。

lines.en: Sure, it would probably make a little more sense if it was her sister instead, but given the...pattern of girls I’ve been seeing, Noriko definitely fits the bill.
lines.zh: 当然，如果是她妹妹的话大概更说得通，不过考虑到我交往对象的……那个规律，Noriko 绝对符合。

lines.en: And even though I’ve been forced into the position of the little spoon, I don’t really feel out of place.
lines.zh: 虽然被迫当起了小汤匙，我却并不觉得格格不入。

lines.en: Then again, I don’t feel {i}in{/i} place either.
lines.zh: 话又说回来，我也不觉得完全{i}融入{/i}。

lines.en: I just kind of...feel, I guess.
lines.zh: 我只是……有感觉吧，大概。

lines.en: Which is more than I can say most of the time.
lines.zh: 这比大多数时候的我要强了。

lines.en: Somehow, Noriko falls asleep before I do.
lines.zh: 不知怎的，Noriko 比我先睡着了。

lines.en: I follow her into the darkness shortly after.
lines.zh: 不久之后，我也跟着她沉入了黑暗。
